entries.reason: Pin-toggle and hide-column are 12px icon-slot affordances nested inside the sort-plumbed header cell (th carries the sort onClick/onKeyDown). Composing the DS Button primitive here would drag its chrome and focus-ring skin into the slot and fight the header's own interaction plumbing; the parts are skin-owned (data-table.css reset), keyboard-native, and mirror the grandfathered Carousel arrow/dot idiom.
